title: FAO Simple methods for aquaculture — Controlling water losses in ponds, §§3.2–3.4

retrieval.scope: Official full chapter body via browser

facts.statement: Puddling breaks saturated soil structure to reduce seepage.
Soil blanket example uses two 15 cm layers, well graded with at least 20 percent clay, moistened and compacted.
Protected subsurface blanket for smaller ponds uses at least 5 cm compacted clayey soil beneath restored soil.
Blankets should be protected against drying cracks and mechanical rupture.

limits: These design examples cannot be used as a minimum thickness specification for a 34 L pottery pit.
Wetness and a roof do not independently establish zero permeability of a 2 cm lining.
